title: Two trapped workers pulled alive from Nepal tunnel more than a week after deadly floods
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. The key update now being reported is: Two trapped workers pulled alive from Nepal tunnel more than a week after deadly floods. In simple words, Two workers in Nepal were pulled out alive from a hydropower tunnel on Friday, some nine days after devastating floods swept the Himalayan region and left thousands of people missing Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. We will continue watching for clearer and more reliable updates.
